hook: MacBook Pro’s 2000‑nit display dazzles — plus 4 more

items.claim: MacBook Pro’s PROLED XDR screen reaches 2000 nits brightness and 10‑million‑to‑1 contrast
MacBook Pro adds on‑screen Touch, enabling gestures like drawing and rotating directly
Gemini 4 Carbon tops SEC‑bench Pro, finding vulnerabilities with 88.2% success
M6‑powered 14‑inch MacBook Pro gives up to 30% faster graphics
iMac’s M6 includes first Dual 16‑core Neural Engine, boosting on‑device AI

caption: Apple’s new MacBook Pro pushes display brilliance and adds Touch interaction. The M6‑powered models promise faster graphics and AI power across laptops and iMacs. Which upgrade excites you more, brighter screens or smarter AI?
alt_text: Five slides list Apple product updates: a MacBook Pro with 2000‑nit PROLED XDR screen, a MacBook Pro with on‑screen Touch, DeepMind’s Gemini 4 Carbon security scores, a 14‑inch M6 MacBook Pro with faster graphics, and an iMac with a Dual 16‑core Neural Engine, each on solid colour backgrounds.

es.hook: La pantalla de 2000 nits del MacBook Pro deslumbra — y 4 más
items: Pantalla PROLED XDR del MacBook Pro: alcanza 2000 nits de brillo y un contraste de 10 millones a 1
MacBook Pro: añade Touch en pantalla, permitiendo gestos como dibujar y rotar directamente
Gemini 4 Carbon: lidera SEC‑bench Pro, encontrando vulnerabilidades con un 88,2 % de éxito
MacBook Pro de 14 pulgadas con M6: ofrece gráficos hasta un 30 % más rápidos
M6 del iMac: incluye el primer Neural Engine Dual de 16 núcleos, impulsando la IA en el dispositivo
